notes.title: Patch 1.2
notes.content: The game is now ported to a newer engine version (Godot 3.5.3) with the result of a better overall performance.

notes.title: This indie strategy game is like a tiny Total War that only takes an hour
notes.content: I like an indie strategy game, especially if it only takes about an hour to wrap up a campaign. Indie Roma Invicta hits that sweet spot with a game of little pixel art Romans fighting little pixel art Gauls and marching all over a little pixel art Europe eating little pixelated bushels of pixel art wheat... Read more.

notes.title: Mod Support is ready!
notes.content:
Hey guys, thanks for the patience! 
Finally it is done, the mod support is ready for you. It was (surprise surprise) more work than expected, but I think it was worth the effort.
I made it as easy as possible, so with just Paint and the Text-editor you can create any unit and any scenario you like.
Soon I will put a documentation here for the details how to do it. Until then feel free to try out the new modules I created for testing ("north vs south" is already in the workshop).
Join us on discord for help and support... https://discord.gg/yf9nc4bwse
In the main menu there is a new option "mod battles", there is the interface where you can load the module.
Please let me know if you find any bugs.
And have fun!!! :D

notes.title: Mod support is coming!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41846536/9b6e55411756afa06a0615b866d0eafcf82a6104.gif[/img]

I want to announce my attempt to implement a mod-support for Roma Invicta. I won't be able to do that for the campaign, but at least for the custom battles. The following is planned...

[list]
[*] soldiers will be customizable by looks and stats (you can even create new types of soldiers)
[*] adding pike-formations so you can implement for example greek phalanx etc.
[*] adding early firearms
[*] steam workshop implementation
[/list]

notes.title: WASD or arrow-keys camera movement implemented
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41846536/b59dd9e60719d41496be945324f212a8cb493436.png[/img]

You can now move the camera using the WASD or the arrow-keys.

notes.title: horse performance improved
notes.content: I changed the animation mechanics of the horses. Now they get their frames from spritesheets. Before they consisted of individual body parts that were animated in real time (as the solders still are). In detail it does not look that smooth, but the performance in bigger battles is now significantly improved.

notes.title: Roma Invicta is a like an indie Total War out now
notes.content:
Like the idea of Total War games but find them complicated or want something similar that takes a bit less time? Roma Invicta is a new indie release that looks promising.

Read the full article here: https://www.gamingonlinux.com/2022/02/roma-invicta-is-a-like-an-indie-total-war-out-now

notes.title: Release!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41846536/6bec2b95da84d9f631372606660db849b18d0b7e.gif[/img]

That is truly an indescribable feeling.
I hope you have as much fun playing as I had with the development.

Of course I would be very happy to receive constructive feedback. But please always keep in mind that this game is not from a professional development company but that I did this alone in my free time... so please be lenient with minor imperfections.

On that note...have fun...ROMA INVICTA!
